notes.title: Demo Update and Next Fest, Potential Release Date, Health Updates and Other News
notes.notes:
The Bigfoot Life Demo has been updated and is now live. Below are some of the updates and fixes.

[h2]Demo Updates and Fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]Small food items like mushrooms and berries are now stackable in your inventory.[/b] You can now quickly eat things from your inventory by using Spacebar as well.
[*] [b]Added in a Bigfoot Knowledge tab in the game menu.[/b] This will provide you with more information about bigfoot and other things.
[*] [b]Foot Size has been added as a customization for the Demo[/b]. The full game already has this feature and more customization options than the demo in general. 
[*] [b]Bigfoot will now jump higher when running.[/b]
[*] [b]Updated some items like being able to light your stick on fire.[/b] It will have more useful uses in the full game.
[*] [b]Fixed human animation stopping sometimes when Bigfoot was holding them.[/b]
[*] [b]Fixed grill lid attachment position.[/b]
[*] [b]Updated and fixed some localization issues[/b]. Also, the Full game is being localized by professional human translators so it will be much more accurate than the demo.
[*] [b]Other small misc fixes.[/b]
[/list]

[b][i]The Demo will also be featured in the upcoming Steam Next Fest in October.[/i][/b]

[h2]Potential Release Date[/h2]

Right now nothing is definite, but there is a possibility the full game could be released as soon as a few weeks after Next Fest at the beginning of November. I will provide more details on this as soon as I can.

[h2]Health Updates and Decision Making[/h2]

If you have followed any of the recent News posts on the Steam Hub for Bigfoot Life you may already be aware that I had a bone marrow transplant recently. I had a rare disease called VEXAS which also led me to having blood cancer. The transplant was successful and I now have a second chance at life. I am beyond thankful for the donor and this blessing.

Since being released back home to Indiana from the NIH (National Institutes of Health) in May I had not been feeling the best and started to get worsening new symptoms. This had made it difficult to make the progress on the game I wanted and to release the game when I originally planned to. Thankfully I had a couple programmer contacts who have been able to help me during this time. Their names are listed under programmers and the developer sections of the Credits in the Demo and Full Game. I am so thankful for the help.

Things got pretty bad a couple weeks ago and I am now actually back at the NIH in Maryland. They finally have a diagnosis for the new health issues. I have GVHD (Graft Versus Host Disease). They are on top of things here and I am very thankfully to finally know what is going on. I will probably be out here for at least another couple weeks while they monitor everything since starting the new treatment.

I've been able to use this time to evaluate where Bigfoot Life is at and what the best way forward for the game is. I believe the best decision is to get the game out to all of you as soon as I can during this time that I am starting to feel a little better. After transplant you just never know when things might happen or turn in the wrong direction so I feel it is best to make the push to get the full game out soon. 

At launch the game may not have all the features or be exactly what I originally had hoped for but hopefully it will still be a good game that players will enjoy to play. I still believe it is important to be able to get the game out sooner rather than later because of the health issues and the uncertainty around that.  I will continue to support and update the game after launch as well. This will allow me to keep providing updates and make the game the best possible game that it can be.

I hope to get a new trailer and screenshots out before Steam Next Fest next month.

Thank you so much for all your patience and support with the game. It means so much to me.

-Wes
Planet 47 Games

notes.title: New Trailer, Screenshots, Artwork and Demo Update!
notes.notes:
I've updated the game's trailer, screenshots, and artwork for the Main Game. This was long overdue as the old stuff was really out of date.

[h3]New Trailer[/h3]
[previewyoutube=gNpOa7WyDtw;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Demo Update[/h3]

Below are some of the updates to the Bigfoot Life Demo.

Added an option to zoom your camera in and out. This was suggested by a few players. This should also help with performance. You can change your camera settings anytime.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45108291/d2899bbfe3f1055a2cfaca92106180909a246b6d.jpg[/img] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45108291/53f15b1289ba947f9be6d868c6160dce84cac67b.jpg[/img]

Added in an option to change to quality of Bigfoot's fur to help with performance on lower end machines. This can be changed during the Bigfoot Creator or any time by going into Graphic Settings.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45108291/5fa77ee09199ac371d07d3995803a43005f45db5.jpg[/img]

-Optimization updates.

The Bigfoot Life Demo will also be taking part in the upcoming Steam Next Fest. Thank you for all the support and feedback.

-Wes

notes.title: Small Demo Update
notes.notes:
A small update for the Bigfoot Life Demo just went live. Below are the updates and fixes in this build.

[list]
[*] Rocks in your inventory will now only take up 4 slots instead of 9. This should allow you to store more in your inventory and less in your storage areas.
[*] Added blue arrows pointing to the tutorial shelter logs when building your first shelter. I noticed some players were having a hard time finding these logs for building your first shelter.
[*] Added text that says "Throw Rock" to branches once you break them with your hand. This should hopefully make it clear that you need to throw a rock at the broken branch to full break it off the tree.
[*] A few localization fixes.
[*] Minor updates to humans and their AI.
[*] Water footstep audio when walking in the water.
[*] Other small fixes.
[/list]

Thank you so much for all of the support and feedback.

-Wes
Planet 47 Games

notes.title: Big Bigfoot Life Demo Update
notes.notes:
I'm excited to announce that a big update has been made to the Bigfoot Life Demo and it is live now.

[b][h1]UPDATES[/h1][/b]

[b][h2]UI Updates[/h2][/b]

The main UI has had been updated. You will now find most everything is to left now. Your current tasks has now also been added to the upper left.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45108291/7314cd8ad42f5375b8242e398606d4c21d897ca5.jpg[/img]

[b][h2]Bigfoot Demo Tasks[/h2][/b]

There are now Bigfoot Tasks for the Demo. You can see them in the Game Menu or in the upper left of your main UI once you have completed all learning station tutorials.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45108291/983968181c53152ef3bad209e390f56613e9081e.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45108291/afa0325daf962e6768ed9580e656e444663b4570.jpg[/img]

[b][h2]Added a Trail and Footprints[/h2][/b]

There is now a trail that runs through the map. Footprints of where you have been has also been added when viewing the map. These reset each day or each time you play the game. You can turn them off in settings under Gameplay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45108291/56ec7109f2f17e2471917e1b0d07be3d2d9fa6b3.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45108291/33df38e84c5d0beb37fc540fabfdd1db0c85ed62.png[/img]

[b][h2]Optimizations and Resolution Scale Setting[/h2][/b]

The Demo has been optimized a little bit more. There is also now a Resolution Scale setting in under the Graphic Settings. Lowering should significantly help FPS on lower end PCs. For higher end PCs you can raise this above 100 to get even higher quality visuals.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45108291/0d67895af519cc94829ace2ea897891da29bb5ad.jpg[/img]

[b][h1]Bug Fixes[/h1][/b]

[list]
[*] There were some collectables you could not pick up in the previous version. This has now been fixed and you should be able to pick up and collect all human collectables.
[*] Sometimes if you were to Roar while trying to break a branch or other things it would cause you to not be able to interact with items anymore. This should now be fixed.
[*] The weather was raining while it was sunny. This would happen almost every day after day 1. This has been fixed and weather changes should be more realistic in this update.
[*] The action menu to the bottom right has been updated and should always show the correct options.
[*] Text for Bigfoot Fog and Trail Cams were sometimes going through trees. This should be fixed now and the text should always be visible.
[*] Other minor bug fixes.
[/list]

[h3]Plans for the next Demo Update[/h3]

[list]
[*] Update throwing mechanic for rocks.
[*] Add or update human interaction.
[*] Localize to other languages.
[*] Keep listening to feedback and updating/fixing bugs as needed.
[/list]


Thank you so much for everyone who has taken the time to play the Bigfoot Life Demo. It means so much to me and all of the feedback has been so helpful in making the Demo even better which is leading to the Full Game itself being even better.

-Wes
Planet 47 Games

notes.title: Bigfoot Life Demo Game Update!
notes.notes:
An update to the Bigfoot Life Demo just went live. Thank you to everyone who has played the game and thank you to everyone has has left feedback. It really helps in making the game better. 

[h1][b]Updates and fixes[/b][/h1]

[h3]UPDATED PICK UPS[/h3]

The pickup system has had a big overhaul. It should be much easier to pick up items now. They should also be much easier to see. The outline for when you are in range to be able to pick up an item has been changed to orange and the outline itself is now thicker.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45108291/ef7557afb47fcfc573b376694911fb2bb1165829.png[/img]

[h3]COMPASS ADDED TO MINIMAP[/h3]

The Minimap will also act as a compass.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45108291/8439c0a0239b161fa3d88ddb2d2cc0112de509af.png[/img]

[h3]MOUSE SENSITIVITY SETTING[/h3]

A Mouse Sensitivity Setting has been added. For now you will find this under Display Settings. This will eventually be moved into a Gameplay Settings Tab.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45108291/fb5d08f1bae75cfbb963b376e0ea2708fc9c5ef3.jpg[/img]

[h3]BIGFOOT FOG TEXT[/h3]

Sometimes you are rewarded with Bigfoot Fog when you break a Tree Branch. To make it more noticeable when this happens, text will now also appear to let you know about the Bigfoot Fog Item.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45108291/3982f85005b0e4150aa9384c334cb6510e5336e5.jpg[/img]

[h2]OTHER NOTABLE UPDATES AND FIXES[/h2]

[list]
[*] The bug that would cause you to not be able to interact with anything should be fixed now. If this is still happening to anyone please let me know. Also provide any information that you can that lead to the issue.
[*] Turned off Motion Blur.
[*] Added "Bigfoot Points" Text when you are rewarded with more than just a few points. For example, breaking branches or scaring animals.
[*] Updated grabbing fish animation so your legs are animated while moving around to try to catch the fish.
[*] Fixed a bug where you could not add Orange Pore Mushrooms to your inventory.
[*] Shrank the size of the squirrels a little bit.
[/list]

[h3]DEMO SIZE MAP COMPARED TO ACTUAL GAME MAP.[/h3]

A lot of the feedback that was received on the feedback form suggested a bigger map. Below is a comparison in size of the actual full game's map compared to the demo map. The full game is much larger and will have a lot more features like missions, tasks, bigfoot skills, modes, and more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45108291/fd1fcfd82435059474c161e5732baefcddd3afda.png[/img]

I just personally wanted to thank everyone again who has taken the time to play the game. An extra thank you to anyone who has left feedback. Whether that was by filling out the feedback form, the steam hub, social media, or emails. This is so helpful. Please continue to do so. The feedback form link in the Demo's game menus is really helpful but you can feedback anywhere you like. This post, the steam hub, social media, or directly to me through email. contact@planet47games.com.


There is still feedback and issues being worked on that will hopefully be fixed in the next Patch/Update for the Demo. Any new feedback or issues will also be addressed if possible.

Thank You!

-Wes
Planet 47 Games
